title: Private Walking Tour of old Montreal with licensed tour guide
includes: Pick up in central hotel or central meeting point
Private licensed tour guide for 2 hours
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Make the best of your visit to Montreal and explore the city most emblematic sites with a local expert. Let your guide indulge you in the secrets that the wonderful city of Montreal holds. 
Alongside one of our professional tour guides, you will learn the history and stories of Montreal during a 2 hour guided walking tour. You will visit the main sites of Montreal, including the old town, the undergrounds city, place des arts, the old port and much more!
Final itinerary is adjustable to your personal interests
